Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale (arXiv 2406.17557v2) · paper method: The paper’s controlled data ablation models have 1.71 billion parameters.

candidate.paperfull.fineweb.ablation-scale

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • They are trained on equal token budgets, commonly 28B or 350B, and compared on selected academic benchmarks. The conclusion (p.10) notes scale and unaligned benchmark-only evaluation limitations.
